bison-horn.desc: Charge with unstoppable force to unleash a wild, bison-like shot at the net.

gou-no-issen.desc: Channel raw force into the airborne ball and fire it at the goal in a brilliant flash of swirling fuchsia energy.

sunshine-blade.desc: Strike from above with a thunderous kick to send the ball crashing like a solar blade tearing through storm clouds.

koori-no-ya.desc: Kick an ice-coated ball along an arcing path to freeze the opposition in their tracks.

answer-boost.desc: Analyze the keeper's every move and strike the ball along the perfect path to the goal.

panther-blizzard.desc: A ferocious snow leopard cuts through a blizzard to devour the goal.

shirousagi-dashoot.desc: Charge forward with a rabbit-like sprint and deliver a springing kick full of flair.

flying-marlin.desc: Soar with the grace of a marlin and drive the ball in a razor-sharp strike.

megalodon.desc: A giant shark appears from among raging waves and attacks the opposing team's goalkeeper.

flash-dance.desc: Float like a boxer and snatch the ball with flawless, nimble footwork.

requiem-dust.desc: Envelop the ball in a holy melody of light and sound, then strike it to purify everything in its path.

burning-hi-no-tori.desc: Launch a flaming header that transforms into a firebird, gliding fiercely toward the goal.

jumping-thunder.desc: Power up a mighty header and strike the ball with a lightning-fast downward volley.

hissatsu-kumagoroshi-zan.desc: Unleash a beastly shot that bares its fangs at the goal, capable of felling even a bear.

hawk-shot.desc: Have your allies boost you skyward and fire a shot as you dive at blistering speed.

tsunami-boost.desc: Ride a massive wave and perform an impressive long shot that rips through the water toward the goal.

buttobi-jump.desc: Jump higher than anyone on the pitch and shoot at the goal with full power from mid-air.

shine-drive.desc: Unleash an impossibly bright drive shot that blinds the goalkeeper.

hinawa-bullet.desc: One player aims the shot while another fires it like a matchlock bullet.

gauss-shot.desc: Spin the ball with both feet to generate a magnetic field and launch a shot with unstoppable force.

fire-tornado.desc: Unleash a fiery shot from midair. The deadly ball enveloped in flames pierces straight to the goal.

dark-tornado.desc: A dark tornado of forbidden power engulfs the goal with its cursed flames.

tenkuu-thunder.desc: Charge the ball with heavenly lightning and drive it earthward in a blinding, electrifying strike.

rainbow-loop.desc: A restorative long shot that paints a rainbow over the pitch.

oil-rush.desc: Harness the unstoppable surge of oil to blast a thick, unstoppable shot at the goal.

kung-fu-head.desc: Utilize kung fu moves to supercharge the strength of a header shot.

double-grenade.desc: Drop kick the ball with both feet for double the power and send it flying like a rapid bullet.

gold-fever.desc: Unearth the treasures beneath the pitch and smash a dazzling, rock-breaking shot.

rose-splash.desc: Every beautiful rose hides its thorns. Graceful moves unleash this bewitching shot.

dynamite-shoot.desc: Blast the goal with an explosive overhead kick that shakes the net.

maboroshi-shot.desc: Soul-like orbs gather together in this mysterious attack that surpasses human understanding.

back-tornado.desc: Rise high up like a bright blue tornado and aim for the goal using a spinning back heel kick.

run-ball-run.desc: Dash atop the ball to accelerate it so it blasts for the goal with boosted speed.

rocket-head.desc: Accelerate to maximum speed using a teammate's punch and fly straight towards the goal, body and ball.

megaton-head.desc: Launch a header, hitting the ball with a giant hand raised above the head.

denrai-houtou.desc: Behold the sharpness of an ancient blade! A shot that cuts straight through the pitch.

cross-drive.desc: A drive shot carried along by a cross-shaped aura formed through powerful kicks in two intersecting directions.

dragon-crash.desc: Harry the opposition with a merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.

ivory-crash.desc: Drive the ball forward with a sharp, elephantine knee strike honed in Muay Thai.

plasma-ball.desc: Use high voltage to surround the ball with plasma before shooting it low at the goal.

kurukuru-head.desc: Spin with the ball and strike a dizzying header straight at the goal.

mermaid-smash.desc: Twist and strike with the fluid grace of a mermaid to send the ball arcing beautifully toward the goal.

freeze-shot.desc: Freeze your surroundings with a glacier stare, and unleash a fearsome ice-cold shot.

love-arrow.desc: A dazzlingly cute and magical show fires a heart-shaped arrow shot.

dinosaur-break.desc: Unleash prehistoric force with a shot that shakes the earth like a dinosaur's roar.

patriot-shoot.desc: The ball is kicked high up and rockets to the goal like a missile.

condor-dive.desc: Leap up and dive sharply headfirst toward the ball, like a condor aiming for prey.

meteor-attack.desc: Slam the ball to send it crashing like a meteor straight toward the goal!

tsuchi-daruma.desc: The ball rolls along the ground and builds power, turning into a crushing dirt ball strike.

hyakuretsu-shot.desc: Deliver a series of frenzied kicks to the ball before unleashing a super shot from mid-air.

dragon-s-tail.desc: Summon a spirit so fierce it grows a tail, then whip it out in a wild, goal-seeking strike.

banana-shoot.desc: Send the ball spinning sideways, bending through the air in a clean banana-curve toward the goal.

rainbow-bubble-shot.desc: Blow a bubble around the ball and then kick it at the goal as a colorful stream!

kyoubou-head.desc: Lock eyes on the goal and deliver a full-swing header with deadly precision.

sidewinder.desc: Kick the ball using acrobatic moves to give it a snake-like winding trajectory.

rapid-fire.desc: Strike the ball at superhuman speed, igniting it in a scorching, unstoppable shot.

flying-fish.desc: Leap up like a flying fish in the open sea to fire a jump shot.

fortissimo.desc: A conducted shot of orchestral magnificence that is accompanied by an exquisite melody.

kamikakushi.desc: Make the ball vanish and reappear, confounding the keeper at the last second.

spectre-magna.desc: Spin the ball with both feet to charge energy and fire it like a devastating plasma cannon.

aim-shot.desc: Scan, aim, and release a lethal shot that hones in on the goal with unerring accuracy.

suisei-shoot.desc: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet, leaving a trail of light in its wake.

phantom-shoot.desc: Manifest eerie ball-shaped will-o'-the-wisps to confuse the goalkeeper.

abisegeri.desc: Kick the ball up with your knee and hammer it down with a sharp heel kick.

guruguru-shoot.desc: Spin the ball into a spiraling tempest that twists and turns to catch the keeper completely off guard.

mach-wind.desc: Generate a strong gust of wind with an explosive run to execute a shot that's too fast for human eyes.

hitotsu.desc: Channel unstoppable force into a single strike to send the ball hurtling with devastating power.

bound-flame.desc: Rub the ball on the ground for friction to create a heated bouncing shot with unpredictable trajectory.

head-bazooka.desc: Flip and smash the ball sky-high, driving a full-force header home.

grenade-shot.desc: Twist the body to build power and drive it into the ball all at once for a knockout special move.

kodai-no-kiba.desc: Execute a shot that bites into the opposing team's goal like a tyrannosaurus biting into its prey.

rolling-kick.desc: Execute artistic mid-air somersaults to build power for an acrobatic shot.

gear-drive.desc: Use gear motion to speed up the shot and give it an unpredictable trajectory.

death-sword.desc: Infuse the ball with shadow energy and shoot. Its effectiveness is that of a deadly blade wrapped in dark flames.

psycho-shot.desc: Lift and control the ball midair with psychokinetic power, then slam it into the goal.

spiral-shot.desc: Spin the ball to build energy, and hit the goal with a swirling, piercing shot.

bouncer-rabbit.desc: Achieved by an extraordinary jumping ability, leap into the air like a rabbit and deliver this acrobatic shot.

snake-shot.desc: Strike with a serpentine drive that twists and coils, leaving the keeper bewildered.

tarzan-kick.desc: Swing from vine to vine like Tarzan and use the momentum to unleash a forceful shot.

spinning-shoot.desc: Rush at the goal like a destructive tornado. The move is difficult to control, but will never miss.

spinning-transam.desc: Conjure a small cyclone while rising into the air, using the rotation to fire out a forceful shot.

sonic-shot.desc: The ball accelerates rapidly to the speed of sound immediately after being kicked.

perfect-course.desc: Analyze the best ball trajectory for a goal, and execute a shot that follows it perfectly.

killer-fields.desc: Two players kick the ball to add a powerful spin that conjures up a purple vortex and blows opponents away.

sunrise-carnival.desc: Unleash a carnival of color and light and send the ball dancing toward the goal with festive flair.

shadow-sword.desc: From a crack in the void, unleash a crimson-black sword that slashes through the ball and enemies alike with deadly precision.

burning-edge.desc: Tear across the ground with flaming claws and blast foes away with a beastly shockwave.

tempest.desc: Summon a sky-splitting thunderstorm and let lightning crash down upon the pitch as the ball surges forward.

air-ride.desc: Transform the ball into a surfboard that can be mounted and used to jump past opponents.

boost-glider.desc: Team up for an explosive speed boost. A flying combination move powered by friendship.

pegasus-break.desc: Smash the ball with a charged, skyborne blow to unleash a storm of lightning that tears through the pitch.

demon-s-bolt.desc: Unleash a swarm of bats to draw in lightning, then strike your target with a shocking blast.

triple-dash.desc: Bolt forward with two allies as an unstoppable trio that barrels through defenders.

the-ikaros.desc: Legendary wings sprout against the sun and the bright light that results blinds the opponents, allowing for a breakthrough.

scratch-raid.desc: Slash the ground with monstrous claws and unleash a shockwave of yellow energy to knock foes aside.

angel-ball.desc: The ball grows a pair of angelic white wings, making the opponent lose their will to fight.

devil-ball.desc: The ball grows a pair of devilish black wings, mocking and confusing the opponent.

super-el-stico.desc: The ball sticks to your feet like magic, dribbling in midair without ever falling.

gussphee-bomb.desc: Drop explosive fruit from your horns to create a smoke screen that obscures vision.

water-veil.desc: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using water that spurts out from the ground.

pamerio-cabriole.desc: Corner your opponent on a cliff, then vault past while sending them tumbling down.

redio-cabriole.desc: Leap past your opponents in a sweeping, elegant arc as fluid and poised as a ballet jump.

kamoshika-cabriole.desc: Race across the pitch like the wind and vault over defenders with a graceful leap.

pegasus-brave.desc: Ascend on immaculate wings and surge forward, breaking through in a blaze of majestic light.

pegasus-red-brave.desc: Neighing skyward, unfurl your crimson and blast through any foes in your path.

fuujin-no-mai.desc: A wild dance too fast for the naked eye to perceive! Trap the opposition in a violent vortex.

brachias-blind.desc: Unfurl wide, vivid wings and unleash a burst of color that overwhelms and blinds your foes.

phoenichias-blind.desc: Let out a piercing cry and flash your wings, stunning enemies with blinding brilliance.

kujaku-blind.desc: Fan out your brilliant tail feathers and dazzle foes with a burst of shifting rainbow light.

gryphbang-press.desc: Drop with a force so overwhelming it makes opponents tremble before they're flattened.

tsukinowaguma-press.desc: Corner your target and throw your weight down, trapping them like prey pinned mid-hunt.

grizzly-press.desc: Loom with terrifying bulk, send foes scrambling, and crush them the moment they try to flee.

univolt-sprint.desc: Kick into a lightning-fast sprint and plow straight through whatever dares stand in your way.

horse-sprint.desc: Carry two allies on your back and charge forward with raw power, bowling through anyone in your path.

flame-veil.desc: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using fire that gushes forth from the ground.

dohma-driller.desc: Burrow underground and strike suddenly as you burst out at your target.

zooma-driller.desc: Tunnel like a drill, surfacing beneath foes to deliver a devastating ambush.

dual-pass.desc: Trade lightning-fast passes until the ball looks like it's multiplied mid-dribble.

southern-crosscut.desc: The cosmic energy and the hunger to win combine to form a cross-shaped explosion that blows away the opposition.

ninin-sankyaku.desc: A challenging dribble move where two players run in sync and carry the ball all the way to the goal.

general-flag.desc: Drive your standard into the ground to call forth a glowing sigil that sends enemies flying.

blue-stardust.desc: Merge countless blue stars into a single streak of light racing across the pitch.

heaven-s-time.desc: Pause time and gracefully bypass the defence. A natural aptitude is necessary to learn this move.

tsumuji-no-yaiba.desc: Coil around the opponent quickly to create a wind spiral that blasts them away.

the-labyrinth.desc: Lure opponents into a massive labyrinth and slip past while they're lost in your cunning dribble.

shippuu-jinrai.desc: Harness lightning as you soar across the pitch, ripping the ball away and sending enemies flying in a storm of power.

spark-wind.desc: Toss opponents into a lightning-charged tornado to shock them, then surge past.

overdrive.desc: Surge forward with supercharged velocity, the ball a blur as you leave rivals behind.

kuroshio-ride.desc: The player stands tall with arms folded as a whirlpool underfoot turns into a dragon and attacks the opponent.

dash-storm.desc: Charge ahead while generating a whirlwind and blast approaching opponents into the sky.

dancing-ghost.desc: Summon wraithlike phantoms that dance around your foe, binding them tight in a chilling display of dread.

machine-gun-beat.desc: Rain down a furious volley of blows to tear through the opposition's defence and drive the ball straight toward the goal.

jigoku-guruma.desc: Two players form a whirling wheel and slam into opponents, sending them flying.

diffuse-chord.desc: Stamp the ball and unleash a cascade of notes to orchestrate a dazzling breakthrough.

aikidou.desc: Synchronize with a teammate to release a sweeping shockwave that trips the opponent.

psychic-bow.desc: Shape the ball with psychic force and fire it like an arrow through the defence.

armadillo-circus.desc: Ride a giant ball with the Super Armadillo Rodeo Clown and smash through enemies.

matador-feint.desc: Whip a red cape to provoke the opponent and easily step away when they charge madly.

atlas-sword.desc: Swing a towering greatsword to cleave the ground and crush everything beneath.

all-delete.desc: Spread a chaotic aura that erases everything in its path and sweep past opponents in style.

u-boat.desc: Dive beneath the surface like a submarine, reading the opponent's movements as you break through.

shiny-feather.desc: Call forth radiant wings with magic, and streak past your opponent with effortless grace.

liar-shot.desc: Whip up a gust and blow opponents away in a whirlwind of festive fun.

soyoyagi-step.desc: Save the goat kid that suddenly appears on the pitch by executing an Easy Breezy!

echo-ball.desc: Pull opponents into another dimension and shatter their focus with a single, haunting strike.

hologram-lock.desc: Summon a massive holographic arm to snatch and toss any defender in your way.

big-card.desc: Slam a colossal card down to knock opponents flying in a hyper-dimensional card strike.

tokkou-buffalo-train.desc: Charge forward as a trio, kicking up a cloud of dust and trampling opponents like raging bulls.

inabikari-dash.desc: Keep the ball under control at blinding speeds. Pass by the opposition like lightning, leaving them thunderstruck.

olympus-harmony.desc: The player's prayer for victory results in a divine miracle that intimidates the opponent.

blackmail.desc: Unleash a spectral glare of burning purple energy that causes enemies to tremble in sheer fear.

sky-walk.desc: Soar over the opponent and bound lightly through the air while advancing forward.

sprint-warp.desc: Accelerate past defenders at warp speed, leaving even sprinters in the dust.

kazaana-drive.desc: Stir up a strong cyclone and dive in, using the air tunnel to go right past the opponent.

ultra-moon.desc: Execute a series of backflips with the ball against a moonlit sky, ending with a perfect moonsault.

decoy-release.desc: Summon multiple fake clones of the player and walk right past the confused opponent.

storm-zone.desc: Whip up a ground-shaking tempest to blind defenders and surge past.

round-spark.desc: Conjure storm clouds by kicking the ball up and zap the opponent with strong electric shocks.

oouchiwa.desc: Whip up a sudden gust with a giant fan to blow opponents away in a move full of festive flair.

reppuu-dash.desc: Unleash a souped-up Flurry Dash and blaze past opponents in a streak of fire.

jackknife.desc: Feign a miss, then slice from behind with razor-sharp water blades.

britannia-cross.desc: Send the opponent flying with a powerful impact wave launched by drawing a magic circle in the air.

white-blade.desc: Create a ring of ice that turns into icy attack blades with the snap of a finger.

toumei-feint.desc: Bend the foe's vision and vanish like a ghost to then slip past like an invisible gust.

ou-no-tsurugi.desc: Take a dazzling sword and swing with all your might. Only one with a royal bearing can master this skill.

bunshin-feint.desc: A high level ninja move that confuses the opponent by splitting into three fast-moving ninja clones.

konoha-rendezvous.desc: Spin hand-in-hand with a teammate, whipping up leaves as you barrel forward.

mogura-shuffle.desc: Use a mole fake that leaves the opponent guessing: will the buried ball strike, or is it just an illusion?

liquid-flow.desc: Melt into liquid form to flow around the defender before they can react.

muei-souha.desc: Synchronize perfectly with your teammates and barrel through defenders in a single, unstoppable line.

magma-carpet.desc: Cause molten magma to erupt and harden instantly, trapping the opponent's legs.

meteor-shower.desc: An overhead strike sends the ball crashing down, raining to earth like a blazing meteor.

mushroom-hop.desc: Bounce off giant mushrooms to leap over foes and scatter spores in your path.

spark-edge-dribble.desc: Scatter out sparks that explode violently! Dazzle the opposition and make them cower.

dog-run.desc: The ball dodges and confuses the opponent as if it has a will of its own.

nobori-ryuu.desc: Summon a red dragon from the ground to break through the opponent's defences.

dig-through.desc: Spin hard, dive into the turf, and tunnel underground to slip past the block.

scissors-bomb.desc: Trigger an explosion at your feet, masking your advance in a cloud of smoke.

prima-donna.desc: Execute an elegant dance that tempts the opponent to dance along.

aurora-dribble.desc: Manifest aurora lights and breeze past your opponents while they're mesmerized.

maboroshi-dribble.desc: Use tricky movements to create an illusion of the player to deceive the opponent while dribbling.

endless-summer.desc: Strike the opponent with three relentless rising kicks with this deadlier version of Pyrokinetic.

asoko-ni-ufo.desc: Shout about a flying UFO to steal your foe's attention, then sneak by with the ball in a cheeky dash.

acrobat-keep.desc: Outmaneuver with swift, sharp steps before charging past opponents in a burst of speed.

silk-road.desc: Weave past defenders against the backdrop of a Silk Road sunset.

tatsumaki-dokugiri.desc: Spin the ball and scatter a cloud of toxic mist, blinding opponents in a whirlwind of chaos.

trick-ball.desc: Trick the opponent with the illusion of a large falling ball, causing them to recoil.

second-life-hoop.desc: Spin the ball with precise, hoop-like mastery to lock down opponents and clear a way to goal.

yamabiko-step.desc: Step and pivot with power to create a whirlwind that knocks enemies off their feet.

niagara-falls.desc: Unleash a towering waterfall of energy that sweeps across the pitch and keeps opponents at bay.

hayabusa-gaeshi.desc: Descend like a hunting falcon and whip the ball back in a dazzling, rapid strike.

elegant-blade.desc: Turn with effortless grace, holding the ball as you captivate the pitch with a picture-perfect flourish.

ayakashi-dribble.desc: Conjure illusions of yourself to baffle defenders and dance past them with uncanny flair.

kamaitachi.desc: Dash in with slicing speed, wrapped in the fury of a raging whirlwind.

rock-n-roll-beat.desc: Pound the pitch with a rock-fueled tempo as you weave through defenders with unbridled energy.

warp-drive.desc: Open a tiny black hole and dash through warp space to reappear ahead.

matrix-eye.desc: Analyze, plan, and strike to execute a brainy dribble that bends the pitch to your will.

asoko-ni-onigiri.desc: Alert the pitch to a mysterious flying rice ball and use the chaos to snatch the ball and break through.

desert-drift.desc: Skim across the sand in a wild drift, slipping past the defender through a veil of swirling dust.

mogura-feint.desc: Apply pressure on the ball to bury it and charge forward underground like an actual mole.

bungee-thrust.desc: Extend the ball like a rubber rope and use its elastic energy to blow the opponent away.

melody-wave.desc: Wrap opponents in the ball's strange, hypnotic melody and slip past while they're distracted.

tsubame-gaeshi.desc: Dive down sharply from mid-air to kick the ball in a curved arch.

zanzou.desc: Move so fast the eye can't keep up. Dodge rivals with this ninja technique.

claymore.desc: The ball burrows underground like a landmine and explodes at the opponent's feet.

kangaroo-kick.desc: Kick the ball forward with both feet, in a move inspired by the kangaroo's jump.

ribbon-shower.desc: Spin your rhythmic ribbons to dazzle opponents and glide past the defence in a flourish.

death-scythe-low.desc: Unleash a low, sweeping strike that skims along the ground and cuts the defender off their footing.

zeroyon.desc: Execute a sprint start on cue to achieve maximum speed in a split second.

gorimuchuu.desc: Do a bizarre dance with pattering feet to stir up a cloud of dust that blocks visibility.

oraora-menchi.desc: Fix the target with a cold, cutting stare that knocks the fight right out of them.

z-slash.desc: Break their balance with a sharp feint, slicing past in a flash that traces a perfect Z.

zigzag-spark.desc: Electrocute nearby opponents with the spark of passion that occurs from the friction of this zigzag dribble.

spinning-upper.desc: Add an incredible backspin to the ball before launching it at the opponent, causing them to be blown away.

burning-summer.desc: Launch a blazing ball with a somersault kick straight into the opponent's jaw.

the-stamp.desc: Transform the ball into a massive sigil and crush defenders from above.

super-armadillo.desc: Curl up like an armadillo and rapidly spin forward, clutching the football while crashing through opponents.

presto-turn.desc: Feign left and right in quick succession to leave the opponent at their wit's end.

super-scan-of.desc: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance and slip past the defence with precision.

boomerang-feint.desc: Transform the ball into a boomerang so that it returns after being kicked.

moonsault.desc: Twist and flip like a gymnast, vaulting clean over your opponent's head.

fuusen-gum.desc: Inflate the ball like a giant bubble and burst it to blast defenders away.

aggressive-beat.desc: Feel your pulse quicken and break through at the speed of sound, leaving defenders dumbfounded in their tracks.

doukasen.desc: Send a blazing ball rolling to their feet and ignite it in a burst at the perfect moment.

endeavor-run.desc: Race at breakneck pace, clawing past opponents with sheer grit and determination.

overglow.desc: Shatter the pitch with a brilliant flash, blinding all in your path and charging ahead.

dokugiri-no-jutsu.desc: Unleash a toxic mist to stagger opponents and dash through the opening.

angel-ray.desc: Radiate a heavenly light to blind opponents and burst through in one swift move.

magic.desc: Slip past in an instant with a vanishing act that defies explanation.

dash-accel.desc: Accelerate to full speed to execute a super dribble move that can't be stopped.

beautiful-hoop.desc: A delicate move for offence that uses an elegant display of rhythmic gymnastics to block the opposition's movements.

soyokaze-step.desc: Evade the opponent with a light and breezy step, like a gust of wind blowing through.

linear-drive.desc: Harness repulsion and suction to hover and drive forward like a motor vehicle.

shippuu-dash.desc: Buffet the opposition into disarray with speed like the wind! Can only be mastered by lightweight players.

tamanori-pierrot.desc: Ride the ball at breakneck speed, dazzling defenders with acrobatic flair.

monkey-turn.desc: Jump around the opponent like an agile monkey and slip past their defences.

noroi.desc: Envelop your foe in a curse to slow them, then dash right past.

future-eye.desc: Scan the opponent and instantly calculate the best route to dribble around them.

hitori-one-two.desc: Add a strong backspin to the ball that enables the player to do a solo double touch.

naminori-pierrot.desc: Stand on the ball and roll it smoothly past opponents by making use of the momentum of the waves.

transmove.desc: A strange teleportation device appears above, swapping you and your foe's positions.

mad-juggler.desc: Lift the opponent with the ball and blast them away with a spinning kick in a mad, unstoppable strike.

tatsumaki-senpuu.desc: Spin the ball to generate a cyclone that kicks up dirt to blind the opponent.

seiken-kikkouha.desc: Form an aura shell and strike with a powerful punch, sending the shell and your opponent flying.

body-shield.desc: Three players line up and support the player in front so that the first player can use their body to put up a strong guard.

mystic-thorn.desc: Summon jagged thorns from the pitch to trap your foe, then shatter the cage to hurl them aside as the ball springs back.

valkyrie-flag.desc: With the gleam of a warrior maiden, charge forward to overwhelm your foe and snatch the ball amid a radiant storm.

kourin-no-ya.desc: Harness the brilliance of the sun and release a luminous arrow that rips through everything before it.

hurricane-arrow.desc: Rush at a cyclone-caught opponent like a piercing arrow while the referee is looking away.

despair-fortress.desc: Summon a towering stronghold of chaos to trap opponents and spread utter despair.

shadow-guard.desc: Summon a swirling shield of shadow and slam your opponent aside to guide the ball back under your control.

hunting-lance.desc: Let out a thunderous roar as you hurl your spear at lightning speed, striking your target with deadly precision.

bloody-encore.desc: Let out a shattering shout, forcing the opponent to falter, then seize the ball.

perfect-tower.desc: Unleash an electrifying double attack on the enemy from the top of a looming tower.

kagome-kagome.desc: Three players form a circle and all slide in at once trapping your rival like a bird in a cage.

mad-express.desc: A triple-train-threat that seems silly, until it hits: blasting opponents away with awesome force.

sigma-zone.desc: Once locked on, there's no escape. Three players converge for this coordinated attack!

ground-quake.desc: Unleash a mighty punch that shakes the ground, stopping everything in its path.

the-mountain.desc: A greatly powered-up version of The Wall that summons a towering mountain to block opponents.

dandorl-crusher.desc: Smash through like a juggernaut as you snort and charge head-on.

gandran-crusher.desc: Plow through like an unstoppable armored juggernaut and snatch the ball with brute force.

buffalo-crusher.desc: Smash forward like a rampaging beast, sending foes flying and ramming them with sheer horned force.

no-escape.desc: Raise up stone barriers from the earth, forming a narrow path of no escape before stealing the opponent's ball.

fox-mirage.desc: Run in a circling arc, kicking up dust to snatch the ball from an unseen angle.

flamey-mirage.desc: Conjure swirling sand to vanish from view, then strike with a sudden tackle.

gyorom-claw.desc: Fix your target with a massive single-eye stare, then swing your claws to snatch the ball.

clupe-claw.desc: Charge forward, stop on a dime, then leap up to rake opponents with sharp claws.

ratel-claw.desc: Lure opponents with a cute facade, then slash unexpectedly to catch them off guard.

garyuu-bounce.desc: Launch off a cliff and crash down with a spinning attack over the opponent's head.

jinryuu-bounce.desc: Curl into a ball and tumble through the air, forcing opponents to shut their eyes in shock.

fukurou-steal.desc: Eyes a-glow with eerie light, you slip through the shadows to snatch the ball.

mimizuku-steal.desc: Drape all except your eyes in shadow and snatch the ball with cunning moves.

dolphanus-splash.desc: Swim across the field at breakneck speed and smash through defenders to snatch the ball.

demon-cut.desc: Execute a hair-raising roundhouse kick that sends out a diabolical shockwave.

barbarian-no-tate.desc: Manifest a shield infused with barbarian strength to intimidate and repel any assault.

rock-wall-dam.desc: Combine The Wall with God Hand to block charging enemies like a dam.

frozen-steal.desc: Obstruct the opposition's advance by freezing the pitch. Shut them out completely at absolute zero.

nekketsu-head.desc: Headbutt the ball with blazing force and blast back any shot with explosive power.

shoot-pocket.desc: Envelop the ball with a special barrier that greatly reduces its power.

crocodile-fang.desc: Snap your arms together like a crocodile to clamp down and snatch the ball.

serpent-fang.desc: A giant white snake coils around the pitch and opens its jaws to swallow incoming shots whole.

kage-tsukami.desc: Manipulate shadows to catch the ball using a hand filled with eerie dark energy.

hanafubuki.desc: Use flower petals dancing daintily on the pitch to reduce the power of incoming shots.

kogarashi.desc: Summon a swirling leaf tornado to guard the goal and knock away the ball.

abare-guruma.desc: Spin like a wheel and barrel across the pitch, knocking back every shot that comes your way.

rocket-kobushi.desc: Form a fist of pure aura energy and fire it to crush an oncoming shot.

power-shield.desc: Generate a shockwave shield in front of the goal to repel even the strongest shots.

wild-claw.desc: Harness untamed speed and leap to seize the ball with raw, primal force.

tornado-catch.desc: Spin against the ball's trajectory to sap its power and snatch it from the air.

yugamu-kuukan.desc: Warp space to create a black hole that attracts all shots towards it.

god-hand.desc: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

god-hand-wood.desc: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

counterdrive-gk.desc: Strike at the perfect moment with an uppercut to block the ball and guard the goal.

doon-shout.desc: Stop the momentum of incoming shots with sheer will, without even touching the ball.

pressure-punch.desc: Descend from above to punch the ball down, crushing any shot in your path.

power-spike.desc: Dive towards the ball from mid-air and use the momentum to slam it to the ground.

makiwari-chop.desc: Chop the ball with the force of an axe swing! Every strike gets slammed to the ground.

sweat-stillness.desc: Gather every ounce of power and catch the ball in a dazzling display of determination and skill.

wild-dunk.desc: Hammer the opponent's shot with a full-force basketball dunk.

rapid-whip.desc: Launch a rapid flurry of punches, then finish with a knockout strike that blasts the target away.

toughness-block.desc: Muscles as strong as steel can take any shot head-on.

excellent-breast.desc: Suck in lungfuls of air and puff your chest to reflect away incoming shots.

killer-blade.desc: Slash down with a scythe-like aura, cleaving every shot in two.

nekketsu-punch.desc: Infuse willpower into your right hand to block goal shots by punching them away.

burning-catch.desc: Catch the ball firmly with a fist of fire. The willpower contained within refuses to let the ball pass.

moonsault-stamp.desc: Use the goalpost to execute air somersaults and make a splendid landing right on top of incoming shots.

swan-dive.desc: Dive from above the goal and crush the ball with a body slam to stop the shot.

bat-attack.desc: Emit piercing, bat-like ultrasound to pinpoint the ball and snatch it with precision.
